$comment: Regression budgets checked in CI, all measured against a production build on a GitHub runner with a seeded user (60 chats, one 200-message chat). API numbers are the p95 of `samples` timed requests after `warmup` untimed calls. Page numbers are the worst of 3 navigations after one warm load, as TTFB and time to visible content. Budgets sit about 3-5x above the measured runner baseline to absorb noise. Bundle numbers are gzipped First Load JS per build target. Raise a budget only when the growth is intended, in the same PR.

bundle.$comment: Gzipped First Load JS per page, page plus its layouts. vercel = `npm run build:vercel` (webpack), docker = `npm run build` (Turbopack).
